_about: Power outage sources used for the 'Nearby outages' panel around the location you search for. type=arcgis: a utility's PUBLIC ArcGIS outage-points query URL (no key, no login). bbox = [west, south, east, north] the feed covers. type=link: no free machine feed, so the app only links to the utility's own outage map. Never add feeds that need a login, an API key copied from a web page, or a CAPTCHA. Restart after editing. See docs/DATA-SOURCES.md.

sources.name: City of Tallahassee Utilities
sources.regionNote: Region shapes: City of Tallahassee Utilities outage map (layer 2). Outage points carry a region number; the utility does not publish customers per region.

sources.name: Florida Power & Light (incl. former Gulf Power)

_served: served = total customers from the US Energy Information Administration Form EIA-861, 2024 data year, file Sales_Ult_Cust_2024.xlsx (column TOTAL Customers, Florida, all classes). https://www.eia.gov/electricity/data/eia861/ . It is the utility's whole Florida total, not one county. Update yearly.

eia861._about: Customers by EIA utility id, Florida, EIA-861 2024 (Sales_Ult_Cust). Used to label ORNL ODIN county reports with the utility's size.

compare._about: Link-only 'Compare on PowerOutage.us' targets by county FIPS. Link only: never fetch or copy their data (their terms allow personal use only).
